backend/main.mo: Defines storage mixin and two public types for render ordering rules and NFT preview metadata.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence entries mapping feature IDs to affected files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten one-line summaries for major frontend files describing layout, behavior, and feature changes.
frontend/index.css: Sets global Tailwind layers and CSS variables for light/dark themes and applies base body and border styles.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell loading the React app with a root div and module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component defining project types, settings, validation, state management, and view routing.
frontend/src/components/ConfirmDestructi: Reusable confirmation dialog component using AlertDialog and a global store for destructive actions.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Create: Dialog for creating a new project with fields for name, symbol, size, and optional pixel-art mode.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/NewPro: Clickable tile that triggers creation of a new project.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Projec: Dialog for editing existing project settings including name, symbol, collection size, and pixel-art mode.
Displays a project overview tile with metadata and actions for opening, editing settings, or deleting.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer showing attribution with a heart icon and link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Responsive navigation header showing project info, navigation buttons, save indicator, and mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/HoverTooltip.tsx: Tooltip wrapper component showing a popover on hover or focus around its child element.
frontend/src/components/PinataKeyGuideDi: Dialog component explaining how to obtain and use a Pinata JWT token, with step-by-step instructions and warnings.
frontend/src/components/SaveStatusIndica: Displays a small text indicator showing save status states such as saving, saved, or idle.
frontend/src/components/VaultPublishingC: Controls locking, unlocking, and uploading a generated NFT collection to IPFS using Pinata, with state handling and progress updates.
frontend/src/components/VaultViewModeTog: Toggle UI allowing users to switch between compact and grid view modes in the vault.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity authentication and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useConfirmDestructive: Provides a Zustand-powered confirmation dialog store and a hook returning a promise-based destructive action confirmer.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, managing login, identity loading, and status states.
frontend/src/hooks/usePinataKeyValidatio: Hook that debounces and validates a Pinata API key using async checks with abort and status messaging.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file indicating no backend queries are used.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles and custom utilities, variables, and motion/easing definitions for the UI.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/Builder.tsx: Builder UI for generating NFTs, handling trait selection, preview rendering, file uploads, and token management.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Dashboard listing projects with create, edit, open, and delete actions using a confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/Preview.tsx: Handles random trait selection, rule validation, and canvas layer merging to preview generated NFT images.
frontend/src/pages/RarityWorkshop.tsx: Manages trait weight initialization, normalization, locking, and adjustment for each layer's rarity distribution.
frontend/src/pages/Rules.tsx: Provides UI for creating, editing, duplicating, and deleting trait compatibility rules tied to layers.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Controls project-level settings including metadata format, blockchain sync, Pinata key validation, and Solana creator management.
frontend/src/pages/Vault.tsx: Generates NFTs using a worker, handles progress, filtering, rarity data, zip creation, and UI rendering of the generated collection.
frontend/src/pages/Workshop.tsx: React page for managing project layers and traits, including adding, editing, deleting, and reordering layers with UI dialogs and validation.
frontend/src/utils/ipfsPublishing.ts: Handles uploading NFT images and metadata to IPFS via Pinata, tracking progress and building metadata with IPFS URIs.
frontend/src/utils/metadataPresets.ts: Generates preview and final NFT metadata based on project settings, supporting Solana, Ethereum, and ICP formats with template resolution.
frontend/src/utils/persistence.ts: Provides localStorage persistence with atomic saves, legacy cleanup, size checks, and loading of the canonical snapshot.
frontend/src/utils/pinata.ts: Utility for validating Pinata JWTs and uploading files, JSON, or directories to IPFS through Pinata's API.
frontend/src/utils/vaultGeneratorProtoco: Defines message types and data structures used for communication between the UI and NFT generation worker.
frontend/src/utils/yieldToUI.ts: Utility that yields control to the browser event loop to keep the UI responsive during long tasks.
frontend/src/workers/vaultGenerator.work: Worker handling NFT generation tasks including DNA creation, rule validation, and optional OffscreenCanvas image compositing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, spacing, typography, animations, and enabling class-based dark mode.
project_state.json: Project state file tracking UI refinement features, pending requests, and overall project metadata.
